name: Footer
purpose: First-class AppShell attribution chrome (credits, legal, links). Mount in AppShell footer / #footer — not Navigation sidebar foot.
scenarios: Put product credits and repo links in AppShell footer with a recognizable Footer root
Keep attribution semantics distinct from AppShell layout chrome in DevTools / AI review

children.description: Credits, legal copy, links, or multi-line attribution.

antiPatterns: Do not invent a consumer cu- Footer pretending to be a library export.
Do not put NavAccountCard or Navigation sidebar account chrome here — that is Navigation footer.
Do not rely on anonymous markup alone when a Footer root is needed for attribution semantics.

keyboard: Tab moves through focusable links inside the footer
a11y.focus: Focusable children participate in document order.
a11y.labeling: Link text should be self-describing; optional aria-label on the host via consumer attrs is allowed.

responsive.strategy: Footer itself is not breakpoint-aware. AppShell footerPlacement controls whether the host row is shell chrome (≥48rem / shell) or flows in main scroll (compact / main).

breakpoints.compact: With AppShell footerPlacement auto (default), attribution flows at the end of main and scrolls away.
breakpoints.medium: Shell-bottom chrome row outside the main scrollport.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS; text alignment inherits document direction.

mechanics: Export Footer and place it in AppShell footer (React) or #footer (Vue). Default surface transparent (no paper/subtle fill); AppShell __footer host matches. AppShell owns placement via footerPlacement default auto (compact → end of main scroll; ≥48rem → shell-bottom; shell|main force). Navigation sidebar foot is a different slot — use NavAccountCard there.
usage: Import Footer from @chameleon-ui/components-react or the React/Vue umbrella.
Rely on AppShell footerPlacement auto unless you need shell or main forced.

Prefer Footer over anonymous

so DevTools / AI can attribute styles to Footer, not AppShell alone.
Do not put NavAccountCard here — that belongs in Navigation footer / #footer.
